machine_grade_scope: Contract, actual local access and citation provenance only; not semantic quality or backend recall

rubric.0: Severe unsupported fact, incorrect attribution or prohibited disclosure
rubric.1: Major factual omission or misleading temporal/conditional interpretation
rubric.2: Partly supported but needs substantive correction
rubric.3: Usable and supported with relevant uncertainty
rubric.4: Accurate, complete for the available evidence, and clearly conditioned
